name: v15.0.0
body:
# What's Changed
## New Features
* Let the GUI colors be choosen via hex values by @IndolikarQuantifier in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4738
* Add arrow style selector by @serebryakov02 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4769
* Increment/decrement circle counter on mouse wheel by @milnadar in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4698
* Add keyboard controls to monitor selector by @serebryakov02 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4811
* Fall back to native X11 capture when the portal is unavailable by @jmcarthur in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4827
* Add option to disable the Circle Counter outline by @bekirsoylu in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4882
* Removed the close on double click on pinned captures and moved it to shortcut which is configurable through config by @IndolikarQuantifier in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4993
* add more desktop terminal emulators to TerminalLauncher by @anushTikoo in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/5010
* Make the UI language picker a filterable search box by @nicitaacom in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4891

* ## Bug Fixes
* Fix capture when logical min/max coordinates are not zero by @rs-pro0 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4735
* Fixing the currently broken macOS packaging for x64 (Intel) by @HackintoshHD in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4795
* Commit text on Esc in text tool by @serebryakov02 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4804
* Fix screen capture ignoring GUI last-region setting by @serebryakov02 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4789
* Fix aspect ratio in selection widget when pressing CTRL by @ElTh0r0 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4651
* Fail fast when the screenshot portal cannot take the capture by @jmcarthur in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4826
* Fix monitor selector stuck after closing via window manager by @renathossain in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4839
* Fix issue in winows cli by @borgmanJeremy in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4881
* Improve windows-cli by @ElTh0r0 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4888
* Fix pin size on Windows for scaled screen by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4907
* Fall back to a same-language translation for unmatched locales by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4932
* Use the installed binary path in the desktop entry actions by @Dev-next-gen in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4950
* workaround to reposition window on Mate X11 by @borgmanJeremy in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4946
* Persist tool size when it changes, not when the notifier hides by @bterps in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4961
* fix(macos): bundle translations inside the app by @fmendezy in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4986
* utils: Add missing iterator in strfparse by @aokblast in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/5012
* Update save dialog file suffix when the format filter changes by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4931
* Refresh launcher region inputs after each capture by @lev-spassky in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/5004
* fix(macos): publish clipboard captures as public.png/public.jpeg by @fmendezy in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4985

## Other Improvements
* update donation info in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md by @mmahmoudian in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4728
* Document hyprland usage by @pol-rivero in https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/pull/4734
